literal: Embraced hands to loosen, grew pale (the) fresh-braceleted innocent woman's forehead.
translation: When I merely loosened my embracing arms, the forehead of this innocent woman with fresh bracelets instantly grew pale.
modern: நான் தழுவியிருந்த கைகளைச் சற்றே தளர்த்தியவுடனே, பசிய வளையல்களை அணிந்த இந்தப் பேதைப் பெண்ணின் நெற்றி பசலை நிறம் அடைந்தது.
explanation: The speaker marvels at the extreme sensitivity of his lover. Even a momentary loosening of his embrace causes her forehead to instantly turn pale with the sorrow of separation. The word 'pētai' (innocent woman) highlights her delicate and naive nature, unable to bear even the slightest physical distance. The image of 'paintoti' (fresh bracelets) contrasts her adorned beauty with the sudden pallor of her forehead.
